question: Where’s the closest stadium located relative to Memory Garden, Mequon, WI?
sql: WITH source_location AS ( SELECT P.geometry AS geom FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%Memory Garden%' AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Mequon%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), all_stadiums AS ( SELECT poi_name AS stadium_name, geometry FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'stadium' OR amenity = 'stadium' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS stadium_name, geometry FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'stadium' ) SELECT stadium_name FROM all_stadiums, source_location ORDER BY ST_Distance(all_stadiums.geometry::geography, source_location.geom::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
